# HTTP routes

Every route the code registers. Generated from the route switches, so a new route
fails the docs check until it is described here.

| Method | Path | Runs where | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/<file>` | Pages worker | Serves the static app and adds security headers. |
| GET | `/__market/*` | Pages worker | JSON 501: a static host cannot reach an exchange feed. |
| POST | `/disconnect` | Pages worker | Same disconnect route on the app origin. |
| GET | `/health` | Pages worker | Same liveness route on the app origin. |
| GET | `/oauth/*` | Pages worker | Broker consent and callback routes on the app origin. |
| POST | `/token` | Pages worker | Same broker on the app origin, so the cookie is first-party. |
| GET | `/<file>` | Local Node server | Static app. Refuses dotfiles, `/private` and its own source. |
| GET | `/__health` | Local Node server | Health probe used by `launch.sh`. |
| GET | `/__market/bond` | Local Node server | SMEST bond terms plus a BSE quote, each cached separately. |
| GET | `/__market/debt` | Local Node server | BSE debt bhavcopy prices, cached per ISIN and per day. |
| GET | `/` | OAuth Worker | Redirects a human to `APP_RETURN`. |
| POST | `/disconnect` | OAuth Worker | Revokes the grant and clears the cookie. |
| GET | `/health` | OAuth Worker | Liveness JSON. |
| GET | `/oauth/callback` | OAuth Worker | Checks state, exchanges the code, seals the refresh token. |
| GET | `/oauth/start` | OAuth Worker | Creates PKCE and state, seals them in a cookie, redirects to Google. |
| POST | `/token` | OAuth Worker | Refreshes and returns a short-lived access token. |
